nom: Viking Revolution Microdermabrasion Face Scrub for Men - Facial Cleanser for Skin Exfoliating

segments.dry: Reviewers whose skin gets dry or dehydrated, including one after a move to hard water, report the scrub rehydrates and revitalizes their skin rather than drying it further.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently report the scrub does not dry out their skin and even helps rehydrate skin that was already dry or itchy; no reviewer reports it as drying.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the scrub removes dirt and buildup without causing irritation.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers report the scrub removes excess oil and helps clear pores without leaving skin feeling oily afterward.

aspects.libelle: Fine, gentle exfoliating grit, not too abrasive
Good value, generous bottle size for the price
Marketing claims like "organic" or origin don't fully match reality
Sometimes arrives opened or looking previously used

extraits.texte: I don’t like the fact that the company advertised this product as being “organic.” That was the main selling point for me to try this product, but I was duped. I attached a photo to show you the actual ingredients. However, upon using this face wash, I was somewhat impressed with the microdermabrasion scrubbing power this stuff has. If it were actually organic, I’d continue buying this product, but I think I’m going to keep looking.

extraits.titre: Perfect small grit cleanserPerfect small grit cleanser
extraits.texte: I’ve been using this for over a year and love it. It’s got small grit in it to help exfoliate along with the salicylic acid, helps clear pores and remove some oil too. Mellow smell. I use it a few times a week. Ingredients: Aqua, Butylene Glycol, Trehalose, Cetearyl Olivate, Sorbitan Olivate, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Cetearyl Alcohol, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis (Sweet Almond) Oil, Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Oil, Portulaca Oleracea Extract, Cellulose, Tapioca Starch, Sucrose, Sodium Hyaluronate, Tocopherol (Vitamin E), Xanthan Gum, Benzyl Alcohol, Glycerin, Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil, Salicylic Acid, Sorbic Acid.

extraits.titre: Overall, a solid facial scrub that works well for regular exfoliation.
extraits.texte: This face scrub has a nice texture that feels exfoliating without being harsh. It lathers well and leaves my skin feeling smooth and refreshed after use. The scent is subtle and not overpowering. Texture: Gentle but effective exfoliation. Cleanliness: Leaves skin feeling clean and smooth. Effectiveness: Helps clear dullness and rough patches. Scent: Light and pleasant. Skin feel: Doesn’t dry out my skin after rinsing. Value for money: Good quality for the price. Overall, a solid facial scrub that works well for regular exfoliation.

extraits.titre: Who would have thought. I didn't ever think about it
extraits.texte: I got out of the shower patted face and exfoliated my face with this scrub on day one of my "every other evening shaving" routine. Let's just say I was just amazed about the scrub ability to remove dirt, build up without irritation. After rinsing this product off my face I felt the difference in skin health and after shaving with layers and Vikings balm it feels like a new face and smooth as well.

extraits.titre: Viking Revolution transformed my facial care regime!
extraits.texte: I don't have an epic beard like many of Viking Revolution's customers do, but I tried their facial scrub anyway because the brand I was using was discontinued. Let me just say that "I love Viking Revolution!" Not only does this product smell good (my wife keeps raving about how great the scent is), but I love how just a dab lathers up nicely and actually moisturizes my skin. My face tends to get dried out in the winter, and this is revitalizing my skin with all the natural oils they use in this product. But the best part is my face doesn't feel oily afterwards, just wonderfully hydrated and relieved! I also like that I can actually feel the little beads inside the cleanser exfoliating my skin, which also leaves me feeling refreshed and clean. I can't thank Viking Revolution enough for making this awesome product! And the price point is great too, especially since your bottle is bigger than most others on the market! I'll definitely be buying more and telling all my friends to try it.

I never had to use face stuff before. However, after moving to Germany (where the water is a lot harder) my scalp and face started feeling itchy and peeled more. My partner who did know about this stuff gave me fancy expensive Asian stuff. Worked like a charm, but very expensive, and I didn't want to waste her stuff on me. I tried some other men's products, for example L'Oréal for men, the charcoal one, horrible stuff.. After seeing this come by somewhere I figured I'd give it a try, but didn't have high hopes seeing all the others 'mens' products from known brands are pretty terrible, but was pleasantly surprised. It actually has a good peeling effect and has no weird residue or odd feeling on your face afterward. It smells nice and feels like it even rehydrates my skin a bit instead of drying it out further. Can recommend!

reserve: Only 14 reviews were available for this product, and most say little about the reviewer's skin type, so coverage beyond dry skin is limited.
